name: Verified Claims Are Fidelity-Checked
description: Every verification should be backed by a passed model↔code fidelity check — a verdict is fully code-grounded only when the model provably reproduces the real code.
rationale: A proof holds of the MODEL. Without a fidelity (conformance) check linking the model to the real code, a 'verified' verdict is only provisional — it may not reflect the deployed system. Fidelity is optional in the current flow, so a missing check is a flagged gap, not a hard failure (hence warning).

examples.passes: Verify(model) → ConformanceResult(passed) linking the model to the real code
examples.fails: Verify(model) with no passed fidelity/conformance check
